name: Price Value Change 1
definition: Value given to a positive or negative price change.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount by which the price has changed.

AmountSign.name: Amount Sign
AmountSign.definition: Indicates a positive or negative amount change.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Rate by which the price has changed.

AmountAndOrRateRule.definition: If Amount is not present, then Rate is mandatory. If Amount is present, then Rate is optional.

AmountSignRule.definition: If Amount is present, then AmountSign is optional. If Amount is not present, then AmountSign is not allowed.
